'''Eotrisa '''was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she resided on the [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eotrisa appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor on Republic Fleet.
